    rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM              : REAL;     (* Peristaltic API liquid dosing pump speed setpoint [RPM] (0.0..300.0) *)

VAR

    bTempChB_Valid                  : BOOL := TRUE;

         x[1] = delta_T_bed (deviation from target sublimation temperature [deg C])

    *)

    rB22                            : REAL := -0.0160; (* Gas flow vapor sweeping mass transfer authority *)

    (* Kalman Observer Estimates and Gains *)
    rState_EstTempDev_degC          : REAL := 0.0;

   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

    bProcessActive              := FALSE;
    bBatchComplete              := FALSE;

    rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
    rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;
    rAcousticIntensity_dB       := 0.0;

    ELSIF (rFreqDeltaBC <= rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) AND (rFreqDeltaAB > rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) AND (rFreqDeltaCA > rTmrFreqTolerance_kHz) THEN

        iHealthyFreqSensorCount := 2;

        iHealthyFreqSensorCount := 2;

    ELSE
        (* Complete Frequency TMR Incoherence: Fallback to Channel A, latch critical diagnostic *)

    iHealthyFreqSensorCount     := 2;
    dwFaultCode.1               := TRUE;
ELSIF bFreqChB_Valid AND bFreqChC_Valid THEN

        dwFaultCode.3           := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rTempDeltaAB <= rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaBC > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaCA > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) THEN
        rVotedBedTemp_degC      := (rBedTemp_SensorA_degC + rBedTemp_SensorB_degC) / 2.0;
        bTempChC_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyTempSensorCount := 2;
        dwFaultCode.3           := TRUE;  (* Temperature Channel C Divergence Warning *)
    ELSIF (rTempDeltaBC <= rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaAB > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaCA > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) THEN
        rVotedBedTemp_degC      := (rBedTemp_SensorB_degC + rBedTemp_SensorC_degC) / 2.0;
        bTempChA_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyTempSensorCount := 2;
        dwFaultCode.3           := TRUE;  (* Temperature Channel A Divergence Warning *)
    ELSIF (rTempDeltaCA <= rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaAB > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) AND (rTempDeltaBC > rTmrTempTolerance_degC) THEN
        rVotedBedTemp_degC      := (rBedTemp_SensorC_degC + rBedTemp_SensorA_degC) / 2.0;
        bTempChB_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthyTempSensorCount := 2;
        dwFaultCode.3           := TRUE;  (* Temperature Channel B Divergence Warning *)
    ELSE
        (* Total Temperature Incoherence: Max selector for safety against cake melting *)
        rVotedBedTemp_degC      := MAX(rBedTemp_SensorA_degC, MAX(rBedTemp_SensorB_degC, rBedTemp_SensorC_degC));
        iHealthyTempSensorCount := 1;
        dwFaultCode.4           := TRUE;  (* Severe Temperature TMR Incoherence Fault *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bTempChA_Valid AND bTempChB_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := (rBedTemp_SensorA_degC + rBedTemp_SensorB_degC) / 2.0;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 2;
    dwFaultCode.3               := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempChB_Valid AND bTempChC_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := (rBedTemp_SensorB_degC + rBedTemp_SensorC_degC) / 2.0;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 2;
    dwFaultCode.3               := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempChC_Valid AND bTempChA_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := (rBedTemp_SensorC_degC + rBedTemp_SensorA_degC) / 2.0;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 2;
    dwFaultCode.3               := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempChA_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := rBedTemp_SensorA_degC;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 1;
    dwFaultCode.4               := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempChB_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := rBedTemp_SensorB_degC;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 1;
    dwFaultCode.4               := TRUE;
ELSIF bTempChC_Valid THEN
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := rBedTemp_SensorC_degC;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 1;
    dwFaultCode.4               := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total RTD Sensor Loss: Force conservative safe trip value *)
    rVotedBedTemp_degC          := 0.0;
    iHealthyTempSensorCount     := 0;
    dwFaultCode.4               := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Overall Redundancy Degradation Level *)
IF (iHealthyFreqSensorCount = 3) AND (iHealthyTempSensorCount = 3) THEN
    wDegradationLevel := 0; (* Nominal Dual-TMR Integrity *)
ELSIF (iHealthyFreqSensorCount >= 2) AND (iHealthyTempSensorCount >= 2) THEN
    wDegradationLevel := 1; (* 1oo2 Degraded Redundancy *)
ELSE
    wDegradationLevel := 2; (* Severely Degraded / Fallback Limp Mode *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: PROCESS FILTERING, PSYCHROMETRIC MASS TRANSFER & KALMAN OBSERVER
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* First-order lag (PT1) digital filtering *)
rFilteredDewPoint_degC     := rFilteredDewPoint_degC + rFilterAlphaDewPoint * (rExhaustDewPoint_degC - rFilteredDewPoint_degC);
rFilteredBedDP_mbar        := rFilteredBedDP_mbar + rFilterAlphaDP * (rBedPressureDrop_mbar - rFilteredBedDP_mbar);
rFilteredChamberPress_mbar := rFilteredChamberPress_mbar + rFilterAlphaPress * (rChamberPressure_mbar - rFilteredChamberPress_mbar);

(* Real-Time Atmospheric Ice Sublimation Mass Flux Calculation:
   Gaseous nitrogen carrier mass flow carrying sublimated vapor:
   P_sat_ice (Pa) = 611.15 * exp(22.542 * (T_dew / (T_dew + 273.15)))
   Y_vapor (kg H2O / kg dry gas) = 0.622 * (P_vapor / (P_total - P_vapor))
   Sublimation Rate (g/min) = Flow (m3/h) * rho_N2 * Y_vapor * 1000 / 60
*)
IF rFilteredDewPoint_degC > -75.0 THEN
    rSublimationRate_g_min := (rFluidBedGasFlow_m3_h * 1.16) * (EXP(0.082 * (rFilteredDewPoint_degC + 50.0))) * 0.42;
    IF rSublimationRate_g_min < 0.0 THEN
        rSublimationRate_g_min := 0.0;
    ELSIF rSublimationRate_g_min > 85.0 THEN
        rSublimationRate_g_min := 85.0; (* Physical sublimation rate ceiling *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rSublimationRate_g_min := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* State-Space Observer / Kalman Innovation Update:
   Compute innovation between measured voted temperature and model prediction *)
rObserverInnovation_Temp := rVotedBedTemp_degC - (rSublimationCeiling_degC + rState_EstTempDev_degC);

(* Correct estimated states using Kalman observer gains *)
rState_EstTempDev_degC  := rState_EstTempDev_degC + rKalmanGain_K1 * rObserverInnovation_Temp;
rState_EstMoisture_Pct := rState_EstMoisture_Pct - (rKalmanGain_K2 * (rSublimationRate_g_min * 0.025));

IF rState_EstMoisture_Pct < 0.5 THEN
    rProductMoistureEst_Pct := 0.5;
ELSIF rState_EstMoisture_Pct > 100.0 THEN
    rProductMoistureEst_Pct := 100.0;
ELSE
    rProductMoistureEst_Pct := rState_EstMoisture_Pct;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: REVERSE PULSE-JET FILTER CLEANING EXECUTIVE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
tBlowbackIntervalTimer(IN := (iState = 30) OR (iState = 40), PT := T#45S);
IF tBlowbackIntervalTimer.Q OR bFilterBlowbackTrigger THEN
    tBlowbackIntervalTimer(IN := FALSE);
    bFilterBlowbackActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

tBlowbackPulseTimer(IN := bFilterBlowbackActive, PT := T#250MS);
IF tBlowbackPulseTimer.Q THEN
    tBlowbackPulseTimer(IN := FALSE);
    bFilterBlowbackActive   := FALSE;
    bBlowbackSolenoidCmd    := FALSE;
ELSIF bFilterBlowbackActive THEN
    bBlowbackSolenoidCmd    := TRUE; (* Fire high-pressure sterile N2 reverse jet *)
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: ISA-88 CONTINUOUS STATE MACHINE SEQUENCING
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_INERT: Aseptic nitrogen purging & pre-flight diagnostics *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bProcessActive              := FALSE;
        bBatchComplete              := FALSE;
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 0.0;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
        rCryoN2InjValve_Pct         := 0.0;
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct     := 15.0; (* Low purge velocity to displace air *)
        rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := 0.0;
        bBlowbackSolenoidCmd        := FALSE;
        bHarvestValveCmd            := FALSE;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0001;

        (* Interlock: Vessel headspace residual O2 must be < 20 PPM for aseptic solvent inertness *)
        IF (rVesselOxygenPPM < 20.0) AND (wDegradationLevel <= 1) AND bSystemEnable THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            IF bRecipeStart THEN
                iState := 10; (* Advance to Cryogenic Pre-Chill *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            bSystemReady := FALSE;
            IF rVesselOxygenPPM >= 20.0 THEN
                dwFaultCode.5 := TRUE; (* Headspace Inertization Incomplete Warning *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_CRYOGENIC_PRECHILL: Freezing tower and bed pre-cooling down to -125.0 deg C *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bProcessActive              := TRUE;
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 0.0;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct     := 20.0;
        rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := 0.0;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0010;

        (* Modulate Cryogenic Liquid Nitrogen valve to cool freezing tower *)
        IF rFreezingChamberTemp_degC > -125.0 THEN
            rCryoN2InjValve_Pct := MIN(100.0, (rFreezingChamberTemp_degC - (-125.0)) * 2.2);
        ELSE
            rCryoN2InjValve_Pct := 12.0; (* Base maintenance cryogenic frost trim *)
        END_IF;

        (* Dwell until cryogenic tower and fluidized bed basin reach equilibrium *)
        tStateTimer(IN := (rFreezingChamberTemp_degC <= -120.0) AND (rVotedBedTemp_degC <= -40.0), PT := T#60S);
        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Advance to Ultrasonic Atomization & Droplet Freezing *)
        END_IF;

        IF bRecipeAbort THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_ULTRASONIC_ATOMIZATION_FREEZE: Piezo excitation, micro-droplet flash freezing *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bProcessActive              := TRUE;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0020;

        (* Lock Ultrasonic Generator to voted resonance frequency (e.g. 48.0 kHz) at 220 W RF power *)
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 220.0;
        
        (* Low-frequency acoustic field in bed to prevent early frozen droplet sintering *)
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := 95.0;

        (* Cryogenic nitrogen injection loop maintains -125.0 deg C counter-current freezing plume *)
        IF rFreezingChamberTemp_degC > -120.0 THEN
            rCryoN2InjValve_Pct := 85.0;
        ELSE
            rCryoN2InjValve_Pct := 42.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Maintain light bed fluidization to distribute arriving frozen micro-spheres *)
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct     := 30.0;
        rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;

        (* Stabilize ultrasonic acoustic horn prior to engaging liquid formulation feed pump *)
        tUltrasonicStabilizeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        IF tUltrasonicStabilizeTimer.Q THEN
            (* Meter sterile API formulation at recipe setpoint (e.g. 35.0 mL/min) *)
            rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM := 75.0; (* Corresponds to 35.0 mL/min *)
            rTotalFormulationDosed_mL := rTotalFormulationDosed_mL + (rFeedFlowRate_mL_min / 60.0);
        END_IF;

        (* Complete atomization phase after target batch volume dosed (e.g. 5000 mL) *)
        IF rTotalFormulationDosed_mL >= 5000.0 THEN
            rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM := 0.0;
            tUltrasonicStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            
            (* Dwell for final falling micro-droplets to freeze and settle into bed *)
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#20S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
                rPiezoDrivePower_W  := 0.0;
                rCryoN2InjValve_Pct := 0.0; (* Isolate cryogenic liquid N2 injection *)
                iState              := 30;  (* Transition to Primary Fluidized Bed Sublimation *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF bRecipeAbort THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_PRIMARY_ATMOSPHERIC_SUBLIMATION: Acoustic fluidization & Model Predictive Control *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bProcessActive              := TRUE;
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 0.0;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
        rCryoN2InjValve_Pct         := 0.0;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0030;

        (* Engage high-intensity acoustic field to break Geldart Group C cohesive powder channeling *)
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := rAcousticSublimation_dB; (* 118 dB sound pressure *)

        (* Superficial fluidization gas velocity regulation: maintain bubbling regime above U_mf *)
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct     := 68.0;

        (* --- DISCRETE MODEL PREDICTIVE HEATER REGULATION --- *)
        (* Target: Sublimation ceiling = -31.0 deg C (safe below Tg' -28.5 deg C).
           Solve 1-step receding horizon thermal compensation:
           delta_T_bed = rA11 * delta_T_prev + rA12 * delta_Moisture + rB11 * u_heater + rB12 * u_flow
        *)
        IF rVotedBedTemp_degC < (rSublimationCeiling_degC - 0.5) THEN
            (* Bed colder than ceiling: Modulate gas heater power to provide endothermic sublimation latent heat *)
            rGasHeaterPower_kW := ((rSublimationCeiling_degC - rVotedBedTemp_degC) * 2.8) 
                                + (rSublimationRate_g_min * 0.125);
            (* Respect SCR thyristor mechanical rating *)
            IF rGasHeaterPower_kW > rHeaterMax_kW THEN
                rGasHeaterPower_kW := rHeaterMax_kW;
            ELSIF rGasHeaterPower_kW < 0.0 THEN
                rGasHeaterPower_kW := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            (* Critical thermal margin approach: Instantly drop electric heater to zero *)
            rGasHeaterPower_kW := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Integrate cumulative sublimated water mass *)
        rTotalSublimatedMass_g := rTotalSublimatedMass_g + (rSublimationRate_g_min / 60.0);

        (* Sublimation Endpoint Detection: Exhaust dew point drops below -52.0 deg C and moisture < 8.0% *)
        IF (rFilteredDewPoint_degC <= rCriticalDewPointDry_degC) AND (rProductMoistureEst_Pct <= 8.0) THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#90S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 40; (* Advance to Secondary Desorption *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

        (* Graceful degradation check *)
        IF wDegradationLevel >= 2 THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

        IF bRecipeAbort THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_SECONDARY_DESORPTION: Controlled thermal ramp to +22 deg C to desorb bound water *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bProcessActive              := TRUE;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0040;

        (* Reduce acoustic intensity to prevent excessive particulate attrition of dry porous cakes *)
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := rAcousticSecondary_dB; (* 85 dB *)

        (* Maintain gentle fluidization *)
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct     := 52.0;

        (* Controlled temperature ramp (+0.3 deg C/min) towards secondary terminal setpoint +22.0 deg C *)
        IF rVotedBedTemp_degC < rSecondaryDesorptionTemp_degC THEN
            rGasHeaterPower_kW := (rSecondaryDesorptionTemp_degC - rVotedBedTemp_degC) * 0.85;
            IF rGasHeaterPower_kW > 6.0 THEN
                rGasHeaterPower_kW := 6.0; (* Limit heater power during secondary drying *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rGasHeaterPower_kW := 0.5; (* Base holding heat *)
        END_IF;

        (* Secondary Drying Termination: Target final moisture reached (< 1.25% w/w) and dew point < -60 deg C *)
        IF (rProductMoistureEst_Pct <= rTargetFinalMoisture_Pct) AND (rFilteredDewPoint_degC <= -60.0) THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#120S);
            IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
                tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iState := 50; (* Advance to Product Harvest *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
        END_IF;

        IF bRecipeAbort THEN
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_PRODUCT_HARVEST: Filter blowback, bed cooling, aseptic bottom discharge *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bProcessActive              := TRUE;
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 0.0;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
        rCryoN2InjValve_Pct         := 0.0;
        rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0050;

        (* Step 5.1: Execute multi-pulse HEPA filter reverse blowback to dislodge all cake fines *)
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#30S);
        IF NOT tStateTimer.Q THEN
            rFluidizationBlower_Pct := 15.0;
            bBlowbackSolenoidCmd    := TRUE;
            bHarvestValveCmd        := FALSE;
            rAcousticIntensity_dB   := 100.0; (* Assist powder dislodgement *)
        ELSE
            (* Step 5.2: Open bottom harvest valve and empty fluidized bed vessel *)
            bBlowbackSolenoidCmd    := FALSE;
            rFluidizationBlower_Pct := 10.0;
            rAcousticIntensity_dB   := 75.0;  (* Hopper discharge acoustic fluidization *)
            bHarvestValveCmd        := TRUE;

            (* Confirm harvest butterfly valve fully opened via position feedback *)
            IF rHarvestValvePosFeedback >= 98.0 THEN
                tSafePurgeDwellTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S);
                IF tSafePurgeDwellTimer.Q THEN
                    tSafePurgeDwellTimer(IN := FALSE);
                    tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
                    bHarvestValveCmd    := FALSE;
                    bBatchComplete      := TRUE;
                    bProcessActive      := FALSE;
                    iState              := 0; (* Return to Standby *)
                END_IF;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_DEGRADED_LIMP_MODE: Sensor discrepancy or abort hold - Cryogenic powder preservation *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bProcessActive              := FALSE;
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 0.0;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
        rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := 0.0;
        bBlowbackSolenoidCmd        := FALSE;
        bHarvestValveCmd            := FALSE;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#0080;
        dwFaultCode.6               := TRUE;  (* Degraded Operation Mode Latch *)

        (* Safe holding condition: Maintain frozen cake safely at -45.0 deg C using cold N2 trim *)
        IF rVotedBedTemp_degC > -40.0 THEN
            rCryoN2InjValve_Pct     := 25.0;
            rFluidizationBlower_Pct := 20.0;
        ELSE
            rCryoN2InjValve_Pct     := 0.0;
            rFluidizationBlower_Pct := 15.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Operator fault acknowledgement to transition back to Standby *)
        IF bAcknowledgeFault AND (rVesselOxygenPPM < 20.0) THEN
            dwFaultCode.6   := FALSE;
            rCryoN2InjValve_Pct := 0.0;
            iState          := 0;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_SAFE_SHUTDOWN: Full isolation, fail-safe venting *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bProcessActive              := FALSE;
        bBatchComplete              := FALSE;
        rPiezoDrivePower_W          := 0.0;
        rFeedPumpSpeed_RPM          := 0.0;
        rCryoN2InjValve_Pct         := 0.0;
        rGasHeaterPower_kW          := 0.0;
        rAcousticIntensity_dB       := 0.0;
        bBlowbackSolenoidCmd        := FALSE;
        bHarvestValveCmd            := FALSE;
        rFluidizationBlower_Pct     := 0.0;
        wStatusCode                 := 16#9999;

        IF bEmergencyStop AND bAcknowledgeFault THEN
            dwFaultCode.0 := FALSE;
            bAlarmPresent := FALSE;
            iState        := 0; (* Reset to Standby *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 6: ISA-18.2 SECONDARY ALARM HIERARCHY & PROCESS PROTECTION INTERLOCKS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Thermal Collapse Safety Interlock: Bed Temp exceeding Tg' during sublimation *)
IF (iState = 30) AND (rVotedBedTemp_degC > rTargetCollapseTemp_degC) THEN
    dwFaultCode.7 := TRUE; (* Product Core Temperature Approaching Collapse Alarm *)
    rGasHeaterPower_kW := 0.0;
ELSIF iState <> 30 THEN
    dwFaultCode.7 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Distributor Plate High Differential Pressure (Bed Plugging / Defluidization) *)
IF rFilteredBedDP_mbar > 45.0 THEN
    dwFaultCode.8 := TRUE; (* Distributor Grid Clogging / Defluidization Alarm *)
ELSE
    dwFaultCode.8 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Sublimation Column Overpressure Safety Relief Trip *)
IF rFilteredChamberPress_mbar > 120.0 THEN
    dwFaultCode.9 := TRUE; (* Column Overpressure Hazard *)
    iState := 99;          (* Force Emergency Trip *)
ELSE
    dwFaultCode.9 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Consolidated Alarm Output Status *)
bAlarmPresent := (dwFaultCode <> 16#0000_0000);

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
